metadata.title: DORA - Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 on digital operational resilience

controls.title: Access management and least privilege
controls.statement: Implement policies that limit physical and logical access to ICT systems to what is required for legitimate and approved functions and activities.

controls.title: Logging and traceability of activity
controls.statement: Implement mechanisms to promptly detect anomalous activities and to log events, providing a reliable, time-stamped record of access to and actions on ICT systems.

controls.title: ICT risk management framework and change control
controls.statement: Maintain a sound, documented ICT risk management framework with controlled, reviewed changes to ICT systems and periodic evaluation of their effectiveness.

controls.title: ICT third-party and supply-chain risk
controls.statement: Assess and assure the integrity of ICT services and components obtained from third parties supporting critical or important functions.
